more_info.overview: Glycerol esters of wood rosins is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks, entire fresh fruit and vegetables, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
The 2018 safety conclusions depended on the pine species and extract composition.
Preparations from some other pine species lacked adequate evidence for assessment.
